# Vertex Solutions
Vertex Solutions is a business services company.
## Core areas
- Startup scaling from India to the US
- Import-export vendor operations
- Middleman services and business connections
- Fundraising support
- SEO, AEO and GEO marketing
- Sales and digital marketing
- Physical marketing
- Hiring and recruitment
- Data brokerage
- Research-specific model training
- AI integration into business workflows
- AI agentic workflows for customer acquisition
- Brand launches
- Manufacturing support
- Factory and manufacturing-unit setup
- Client acquisition for manufacturing businesses
## Positioning
Vertex Solutions focuses on practical business execution across growth, technology, sales, marketing, operations and expansion.
